title: Çılbır (poached eggs on garlic yoghurt)
steps: Stir the yoghurt with crushed garlic and salt and spread it on two plates.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3–4 minutes and place them on the yoghurt.
Melt the butter and stir in the paprika and chilli flakes.
Drizzle the spiced butter over the eggs, sprinkle with dill and serve with bread.
